serie: Loretta's Clean Home (The Church Lady Way): an 81-year-old Iowa church lady shows, in her own little farmhouse, the old right way to clean one thing
acciones: spraying, wiping with a rag, scrubbing with an old toothbrush, pouring vinegar, lifting the toilet seat, holding a little hand mirror under the rim
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.bano: Loretta's small old farmhouse bathroom: white porcelain toilet with a white plastic seat, white square wall tiles up to waist height and pale painted wall above, a white pedestal sink with chrome taps, a small window with a white lace half-curtain, a white bath mat, worn white hexagon tile floor, a wicker basket with folded towels
lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s white farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar
lugares_fijos.lavadero: the small laundry corner off Loretta's kitchen: an old white top-loading washer and dryer, a deep white utility sink, a wooden shelf with plain unlabeled jugs and bottles, a mop and a bucket, a cotton clothesline basket
lugares_fijos.bajo_pileta: the open cabinet under Loretta's bathroom sink: a plastic caddy with plain unlabeled spray bottles, a jug of white vinegar, a brown bottle of peroxide, a box of baking soda, folded old rags, yellow rubber gloves

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
